commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+6' The referee is firm and issues Ladislav Krejci (Girona) a deserved yellow card.
90+5' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+4' Arnau Martinez is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Min-Soo Kim (Girona).
90+3' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+2' David Lopez (Girona) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+1' Arnau Martinez (Girona) receives a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' The referee shows the yellow card to Daley Blind (Girona).
85' Diego Martinez has decided to substitute Kirian Rodriguez and he is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
85' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card.
85' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is the one who receives a yellow card.
85' David Lopez (Girona) is penalised.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) for Viti.
79' Chance! Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
77' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Martin Juan Carlos (Girona) is shown a red card off the pitch!

74' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Paulo Gazzaniga.
72' Donny van de Beek (Girona) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
70' Substitution. Fabio Silva is replaced by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas).
70' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

69' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' The attendance is 21506.
66' Here comes a substitution. Daley Blind (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Silvi Clua Oya.
65' It looks like Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

63' Great solo effort by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
62' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Quintero signals a foul.
60' That's the end of the game for Manuel Fuster, who is replaced by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas).
59' Diego Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) replacing Jose Campana.
58' Ooh that was close! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

55' Bojan Miovski (Girona) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
55' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Quintero signals a set piece.
51' Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
47' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+2' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Michel is forced to make a change. Alejandro Frances is unable to continue due to injury, Papa Ba (Girona) comes on.
43' Michel (Girona) gets a yellow card, off the field.
42' 1 - 0 What a hit! Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
41' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
40' Alejandro Frances (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' The foul by Ladislav Krejci (Girona) was seen by Alejandro Quintero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
38' An attempted cross from Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
33' Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner kick. The ball is cleared after Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
29' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Arnau Martinez (Girona) but poses no threat.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.

26' Arnau Martinez (Girona) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Jasper Cillessen, who pulls off a stunning save!
24' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post.
23' Silvi Clua Oya (Girona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
21' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
21' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
15' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
13' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
12' The Las Palmas players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Goal disallowed! Donny van de Beek (Girona) scores but Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Girona fail to score from a corner as Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) leaps to collect the ball.
3' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
3' A cross from Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Girona will kick the game off.
Alejandro Quintero will supervise the game today.
